description: Cestná mapa ČSSR 1 : 50 000 (1. vydanie) is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by tiles.geocloud.gov.sk. The thematic map work was published by the Central Administration of Geodesy and Cartography in 1961 - 1962 on topographic basis and in the sheet of military topographic maps 1: 50,000 in Gauss - Kruger's depiction with the thematic layer of the road network. Data are only available for the centre of Slovakia. Coverage: SK. The portal shows the English title as "Road map of Czechoslovakia 1 : 50 000 (1st edition)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Historické mapy. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMTS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
